edits.new: R50 remaining UM obligations include the general two-witness domain beyond single-home with Z empty, unknown witness search, and general strong-moment gap/rounding. For finite explicit nonnegative binary-rational unweighted XOS, one deterministic total-bit-polynomial actual allocation now satisfies all comparator-matching inequalities and all positive fractional benchmarks simultaneously; for the explicit norm1 menu with feasible positive-support unit-FSLP, the stated C/D/E normalization, shared-singleton REPAIR promise test and complete original-job flat-UM schedule are proved. An application to oracle-only XOS, a general subadditive backend, or a source not proved to preserve the explicit norm1 states and positive-support LP still needs its own input/algorithm proof. This result does not give an all-group constant minimum, an all-machines (2-epsilon) bound, a general UM solver or a hardness-source reduction. The fixed-order norm-greedy counterexample addresses its specified extraction rule only.
